item.title: Homeland Security suspends TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — The U.S. Department of Homeland Security is suspending the TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs as a partial government shutdown continues. Both of the programs will temporarily cease beginning on Sunday at 3 a.m. PST, The Hill reported. The programs are designed to help speed registered travelers through security lines. [...]
